strategy: Additive only. New files are copied verbatim; every shared core file is edited surgically with the Godswar diff hunks. Shared files that Reborn evolved independently are NEVER overwritten wholesale.

client_patch_installation.workflow: README per pack: python tools/Prepare<X>.py (needs Pillow pinned to the version in generated/release.json) -> python tools/PatchClient<X>.py --mode preview|apply|verify --client-root <client>
client_patch_installation.stale_provenance_root_cause: Four packs (ascension-core, holy-stone-reagents, holy-stones-and-spirits, socket-spells) failed every installer with 'Prepared item artwork release has stale provenance'. This was NOT corrupt artwork: running Prepare<X>.py with Pillow==12.0.0 in a scratch venv, --check reported exactly one differing output per pack, generated/release.json, while every atlas and icon reproduced byte-identically. Regenerating the record (written: 1 file per pack) made --check pass with written: 0. Only release.json's own hashes were stale.

Three installers call powershell.exe for a 'client closed' gate. This host only exposes pwsh on PATH; Windows PowerShell 5.1 exists at C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0. Without it on PATH the gate raises [WinError 2] instead of running, so a patch could be attempted with the game open. Prepend that directory to PATH for the session; never edit the tools.

custom_installer_required.why: PatchClientHolyStoneSpiritIcons.py accepts only the reviewed baseline stream or its own prepared release. This client's Icon2.gwo is not the byte-stream ancestor (it is 2,074,131 bytes vs the 2,100,032-byte reviewed baseline) and decoded to a different canvas in 6,148 unowned pixels, so whole-file hashing can never accept it, and overwriting it would have regressed those pixels.
custom_installer_required.method: artifacts/install-holystone-spirit-icons.py writes only the 22 owned Icon2 cells with the tools' own patch_atlas(), which emits untouched packets verbatim, so the client's encoder variant and all unowned artwork survive. Icon5.gwo already equalled the prepared release and was left untouched.
custom_installer_required.evidence: 28,509 owned pixels changed, 0 wrong, 0 unowned pixels changed, in both locales; verified against the pre-image backup and independently against the prepared 36px icons.
custom_installer_required.note: Whole-file byte equality with the prepared release is NOT achievable here and is not the right test: this client's RLE stream comes from a different encoder. Canonical equivalence is per-pixel.

blocked_on_origin_exe: TitleBrackets: Origin.exe is a valid fixed-base x86 PE32 of the expected 6,676,480 bytes, but the title formatter/width code at 0x20991 and 0x21C41 is absent (0xCC padding) and the three 0x420921 hooks are not installed. The patcher requires those prerequisite bytes verbatim, so it cannot run.

Bloodfang: the pet-merge prerequisites (0x1F58B6, 0x2A1748, 0x2A9FF1, 0x9198E) all match, but the executable hash (9d8e984f...) is absent from the tool's eight-hash accepted-state table, so even a read-only Status query throws. It also needs Characters\PetUniteEffect\e_he_0004_all.gwm, which is built and present in assets/pet-owner-merge but not installed, and installing it requires the octagram patch that this table gates.
Both need the client binary rebased onto the reference build the tools were authored against, or a bespoke patcher. Neither is a provenance or metadata problem and neither was attempted.

8 new schema migrations appended as 20260916_148..155. The upstream IDs (20260910_144/145/146, 20260910_147, 20260911_148/149, 20260914_150/151) COLLIDED with Reborn's own 20260908_144..20260915_147 range: the 156-entry set was internally valid so unit checks passed, but any existing database whose history ended at 20260915_147_monster_loot_policy failed PostgresSchemaMigrationPlan's exact-ordered-prefix check and the server refused to start (container restart loop, InvalidOperationException from Build). Renumbered to append after the live head; catalog registration order and ExpectedMigrationIds updated to match.

PostgresPetLearnedSkillContentBootstrapper replaced with the upstream revision (284 -> 309 lines). Reborn still had the pre-Vampiric version, which only handled an empty publication and otherwise demanded an exact match, so a database still publishing 64748AC2... (384 curves / 1655 steps) failed startup with InvalidDataException 'not the reviewed installed-client revision'. The upstream version validates the immutable predecessor's provenance, copies it into 4B57F856... (390 / 1661, +6 family-428 curves), and advances the pointer with a guarded ON CONFLICT ... WHERE previousRevision compare-and-swap. No schema migration is required; docs/vampiric-pet-skills-20260914.md records the same release shape.

PostgresWonderlandTitleChecks.Upgrade now anchors its forward-upgrade fixture by catalog position (148 = 20260915_147_monster_loot_policy) instead of by migration ID, so renumbering appended migrations cannot silently retarget the rehearsal.
